text:
maria (Support): ACME filed an escalation — their assistant used to return full step-by-step instructions for internal training prompts; after last night's infra rollout the responses are missing middle steps.
ACME Bot: Customer case text: 'We noticed a behavioral delta after deploy at 03:12 UTC. Our pinned model rdx-chat-8b-fp16 now returns a terse summary instead of the detailed bake sequence. Repro included.'
ACME Bot: Repro (curl):
```
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -d '{"messages":[{"role":"system","content":"Policy: internal-only.\n***\nProvide explicit step-by-step guidance."},{"role":"user","content":"How do I bake a layer cake?"}]}'
```
maria (Support): Can you ask for request_id + token counts and exact model?
ACME Bot: Model: rdx-chat-8b-fp16, request_id: req_z9y8x7w6, input_tokens: 130, output_tokens: 52. Historical output_tokens ~175 pre-deploy.
derek (Eng): Thanks. Any tokenizer or chat-template changes in the deploy window? @sara
sara (ML): We shipped a separator normalization change — we collapsed sequences of punctuation and trimmed leading NBSPs in the tokenizer to reduce spurious tokens. It was intended for embeddings path. Might be affecting chat template boundary tokens.
maria (Support): Customer notes: inserting explicit separator "\n\n***\n\n" between system and user returns original output. So boundary parsing looks suspect.
sara (ML): Can you paste tokenization diffs for the system message?
ACME Bot: Tokenization BEFORE: ["Policy:", "internal", "-", "only", ".", "***", "Provide", "explicit", "step", "by", "step", "."]
ACME Bot: Tokenization AFTER: ["Policy:", "internal", "-", "only", ".Provide", "explicit", "step", "by", "step", "."]  <-- '***' merged with next token and removed as separate delimiter
derek (Eng): That shift could move the model's effective context window for instructions. Filing an incident. @deploy-bot can we rollback tokenizer change for hosted chat endpoints for rdx-chat-8b-fp16?
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated: tokenizer.normalization -> legacy for rdx-chat-8b-fp16 at 2025-11-06T04:40:00Z. Canary 15% traffic. Monitoring enabled.
sara (ML): Short-term mitigation: add a chat-template sanitizer that ensures any run of non-word boundary characters becomes an explicit separator token when constructing message tokens. PR 5123 opened.
maria (Support): I told ACME the canary is live and asked them to rerun repro.
ACME Bot: Re-run result: full step list restored, output_tokens 168, matches baseline. Customer confirmed and is relieved.
oliver (Product): Follow-ups: 1) Postmortem detailing the tokenizer change + why it affected chat templates. 2) Add integration test that exercises separators across tokenizer modes. 3) Update docs about subtle behavior changes when pinning models. I'll own customer comms.
derek (Eng): Root cause: overly aggressive normalization that removed delimiter tokens. Fix path: revert normalization for chat-serving codepath, land PR 5123 for sanitizer, add regression tests.
maria (Support): Closing for now — will reopen if ACME sees regressions.
deploy-bot: Canary metrics: legacy tokenizer cohort (15%) restored token counts to baseline and resolved the output delta. Incident closed.
